alder: Mount Alder is 2,140 metres tall and sits in the Northern Range. The first recorded ascent was in 1893 by a survey team. The summit is closed to climbers between November and March because of avalanche risk. A visitor centre at the base opens daily at 8 a.m. Entry to the park costs 12 dollars for adults.
voltra: The Voltra X battery pack stores 60 kilowatt-hours of energy. It supports fast charging at up to 150 kilowatts, which restores 80 percent of capacity in 35 minutes. The pack is warranted for eight years or 160,000 kilometres. It does not support bidirectional charging. Cold weather reduces usable range by roughly 20 percent.
library: Members may borrow up to ten books at a time. Standard loans last 21 days and can be renewed twice. Overdue items incur a fine of 0.25 dollars per day. Reference books may not leave the building. Children under twelve need a parent's signature to register.
report: Revenue grew 14 percent in 2024 to 82 million dollars. Operating costs rose 9 percent, driven mainly by hiring in the engineering team. The company opened offices in Lisbon and Toronto. Headcount ended the year at 410 employees. No dividends were paid.
medicine: Take one tablet twice daily with food. Do not exceed four tablets in 24 hours. Drowsiness is a common side effect, so avoid driving until you know how the medicine affects you. The tablets should be stored below 25 degrees Celsius. Not recommended for children under six.
flood: The Marlow river flooded in March after three days of heavy rain. Water levels peaked at 4.8 metres on March 14. Around 300 residents were evacuated from the lower district. The old stone bridge remained open throughout. Repairs to the embankment are expected to finish in August.
